content.title: KITCHEN CABINET FIXES FOR ANNOYING {{LITTLE}} AILMENTS
facts: Hiccups – Slowly sip a glass of **ice-cold water** without pausing to breathe.
Sore Throat – Gargle with **warm salt water** a few times a day to ease irritation.
Nosebleed – Pinch the **soft part of your nose** and lean slightly forward for a few minutes.
Hangnail – Soak the finger in **warm olive oil** to soften the skin before trimming.
Stuffy Nose – Inhale steam from a bowl of **hot water** to loosen congestion.
Muscle Cramp – Gently stretch and press a **cold compress** on the tight muscle.
Splinter – Apply a piece of **tape** and peel it off to lift small splinters out.
Dry, Cracked Heels – Rub crushed **oatmeal and honey** paste on feet before rinsing.
Minor Burn – Hold the area under **cool running water** for several minutes, not ice.
Bad Breath – Chew on a **fresh parsley sprig** to freshen breath naturally.
